text:
morgan: Heads-up: want to update the routing salt used by routing-priority from `cohort_hash_v1` -> `cohort_hash_v2`. This will reassign some users to the low-latency pool. Plan is shadow + small canary + telemetry gates. Want to coordinate console preview + quota migration.

raj: +1 on shadow. Recommend starting at 0.2% traffic for 12h so we can collect stable percentile estimates. Key signals: p50/p90/p95, request_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, and cost_per_token.

anya: Console needs a preview endpoint (POST /v1/preview/cohort-diff) and a transient table for diffs so product can inspect identities. We should also add a toggle in the UI to flip `preview` on for owners only.

sam: Important: feature-flag vs runtime-config distinction. If this is behind a feature-flag we can gate the rollout at config layer and flip quickly. If it's baked into runtime-config we need a rollback path that preserves legacy hashing for existing quota keys.

helen: Quota mapping note: our quota service keys are derived from hash(user_id) + shard. Changing salt will create new keys. Proposal: read legacy key first, then check new key; if legacy present, return that quota until migration TTL expires. We'll mark new keys with `migration_state=pending` and run a background backfill job `quota-migrate-v2` with id qmv2-1768.

ops-bot: snapshot: config-snapshot created auto-1768124680 (routing-salt-proto) owners: morgan, helen.

morgan: Rollout sketch: 1) Shadow (x-rw-shadow header + preview tagging) 0.2% 12h 2) Owner preview via console 3) Canary 2% for 1h 4) 10%/50%/100% with telemetry gates. Need dashboards, alert thresholds, and an ops rollback runbook.

raj: Example PromQLs I'll add to eval job:
```
# trimmed mean latency per salt
avg_over_time((sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_sum{job=\"router\",routing_salt=~\"cohort_hash_v2|cohort_hash_v1\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_count{job=\"router\",routing_salt=~\"cohort_hash_v2|cohort_hash_v1\"}[5m]))) [30m:]) by (routing_salt)
```
Also: `sum(rate(errors_total{job=\"router\",routing_salt=\"cohort_hash_v2\",preview=\"true\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{job=\"router\",routing_salt=\"cohort_hash_v2\",preview=\"true\"}[5m]))` for shadow error-rate.

anya: For the console diff, I'll store snapshots with fields: cohort_id, legacy_hash_bucket, new_hash_bucket, affected_pct. UI will show sample user ids (hashed) and a histogram. We'll gate visibility to owners and compliance. PR incoming.

sam: Shadow behavior: router should duplicate decision but not side-effect. Add header `x-rw-shadow: 1` and router sets `x-rw-skip-side-effects: true` when present. Also shadow should use a light path: hit cache/probe model instead of full model call.

helen: Migration TTL propose: 48h. During TTL reads prefer legacy; writes increment both legacy and new keys while TTL active. Backfill job qmv2-1768 will reconcile counts and emit audit log entries `quota.migrate.create`.

morgan: Owners: @anya console preview + small DB schema @raj evals + alerts, @helen quota migration and backfill, @sam router shadow guardrails.

raj: Alerts: channel #ops-alerts. Conditions: shadow_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95_delta(cohort_hash_v2 vs cohort_hash_v1) > 75ms for 10m OR token_cost_pct_change > 12% for 15m. Use bootstrap CI on percentiles since sample small.

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled at 1768124920 for routing-salt-canary. Auto-abort if `shadow_error_rate > 0.5%` sustained 5m.

sam: Runtime failover: if p95_delta > 75ms for affected cohort_id set, revert traffic for that cohort_id to legacy salt for 30m and mark cohort in console as `failed-rollout`. Also implement a slow-ramp where each step waits for signal.

anya: I'll add a dashboard panel: "Cohort salt diff" showing redistributions, sample user impact, and a small diff table. Also audit trail panel for quota key creations.

helen: Implementation detail: create new `cohort_mapping_v2` table with columns (cohort_id, new_bucket, created_at, migration_state). A small reconciliation Lambda will run every 5m during TTL.

morgan: Schedule: dry-run tomorrow 08:00 PST. Quick sync 07:40 PST 15m allowed. I'll draft runbook: commands to revert config, how to trigger backfill, and billing contact steps.

raj: I'll push the eval job and add a canary CI that computes bootstrap CIs for p95 and reports to the dashboard.

sam: I'll open router PR to add shadow header handling + side-effect skip + cheap-probe path.

morgan: thanks. please drop PR links and dashboard links here after merge. Also ensure SRE and billing are pinged when canary runs.

ops-bot: reminder set: dry-run reminder 1768124820 (20m before).
